measured_executable.disassembly_observation: Actual executable contains gettimeofday PLT calls followed by seconds*1000000+microseconds arithmetic and unsigned elapsed subtraction.

retained_alternative_search.scope: Targeted search; not a complete filesystem inventory.

package_source_provenance: The .dsc SHA256 and Debian tar SHA256 match the official Ubuntu release announcement; original source tar SHA256 matches that .dsc. Detached PGP signature verification was not performed.

changes: time_us uses clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) and converts nanoseconds to microseconds

semantics.timeout_counter: Completed responses whose unsigned measured latency is outside the configured histogram range increment timeout; the counter is not proof of a socket-level disconnect or elapsed two-second deadline.
semantics.underflow: A backwards wall-clock step larger than the true request interval makes now-start wrap modulo2^64, above the histogram limit; completed request and byte totals still include that response, while latency statistics omit its rejected sample.
semantics.monotonic_change: Only request/rate/overall elapsed timestamps change clock domain; actual durations above the same timeout continue to increment the original counter.

limitations: Observed clock steps and short printed maximum latency are consistent with unsigned underflow, but do not prove every historical timeout has this cause. Root is correlating stock-wrk windows with the independent monitor before any new workload.
The minimal patch leaves ae.c event-loop scheduling on wall time; this is deliberately not a broader event-loop rewrite.

Rebuilding may change code generation relative to the distro binary. Recipe builds matched stock and monotonic executables with identical compiler/flags/libraries; only src/wrk.c may differ between the matched source trees.
